title: Aeration Blower Delayed Start
requirements:
Control a wastewater-treatment aeration blower with a low-dissolved-oxygen demand, a five-scan start delay, emergency-stop priority and start-cycle counting.

1. Start delay timing when both DO_LOW and AERATION_E_STOP_NC are TRUE. Allow BLOWER_RUN to become TRUE only after these conditions have remained satisfied for five consecutive scans.
2. If DO_LOW becomes FALSE or an emergency stop occurs, immediately disable BLOWER_RUN and reset the start timer, whether timing is incomplete or complete. A new demand must wait five consecutive scans again.
3. Increment AERATION_BLOWER_CYCLE_COUNT once on each FALSE-to-TRUE transition of BLOWER_RUN. Do not count repeatedly during continuous operation.
4. At power-up, initialize the blower to OFF and the start count to zero. The start delay gates a BOOL enable; no continuous speed ramp is required.
The current input scan counts as the first qualifying scan. Start on the fifth qualifying scan.

variables.name: DO_LOW
variables.description: Dissolved oxygen is below its threshold and aeration is needed.

variables.name: AERATION_E_STOP_NC
variables.description: TRUE means the emergency stop is inactive; FALSE means it is active.

specs.text: 当急停按下（AERATION_E_STOP_NC=FALSE）时，鼓风机运行命令必须为 FALSE。
当低氧需求为 FALSE 时，鼓风机运行命令必须为 FALSE。
鼓风机连续运行期间（本拍与上一拍都在运行）启动计数不得增加。
前四个连续有效扫描保持停机，第五拍启动；运行信号从假到真时计数一次。
连续五拍低氧且急停释放才启动，需求中断须重新等待。
specs.ltl: G(BLOWER_RUN <-> ((DO_LOW AND AERATION_E_STOP_NC) AND prev(((DO_LOW AND AERATION_E_STOP_NC) AND prev(((DO_LOW AND AERATION_E_STOP_NC) AND prev(((DO_LOW AND AERATION_E_STOP_NC) AND prev((DO_LOW AND AERATION_E_STOP_NC))))))))))

specs.text: 可表示范围内每次启动沿计一次，其他拍保持计数。原题未约定65535后再次启动的溢出处理。
specs.ltl: G(((rising(BLOWER_RUN) AND NOT prev(AERATION_BLOWER_CYCLE_COUNT = 65535)) -> AERATION_BLOWER_CYCLE_COUNT = prev(AERATION_BLOWER_CYCLE_COUNT) + 1) AND (NOT rising(BLOWER_RUN) -> AERATION_BLOWER_CYCLE_COUNT = prev(AERATION_BLOWER_CYCLE_COUNT)))

test_cases.note: 低氧且无急停连续 5 拍：第 5 拍启动延时到点，BLOWER_RUN 置 TRUE 并在这一拍把计数加到 1（以周期数代替 5 秒）
只满足 4 拍：延时差一拍，风机不启动、计数保持 0（边界下方，负例）
连续运行 7 拍：只在第 5 拍的上升沿计一次数，持续运行期间不得重复计数（负例）
低氧需求不存在：连续 7 拍也不启动、不计数（负例）
急停按下（AERATION_E_STOP_NC=FALSE）压过启动延时：不启动、不计数（负例）
上电第 1 拍：延时计时刚开始，风机 OFF、计数为 0（上电初始化边界）
连续运行 10 拍：仍只计 1 次启动，计数不随运行时间增长

raw_text:
# Aeration Blower Delayed Start

- **Difficulty:** Easy (easy)

## Requirements

Control a wastewater-treatment aeration blower with a low-dissolved-oxygen demand, a 5-second start delay, emergency-stop priority and start-cycle counting.

1. Start delay timing when both DO_LOW and AERATION_E_STOP_NC are TRUE. Allow BLOWER_RUN to become TRUE only after these conditions have remained satisfied for 5 seconds.
2. If DO_LOW becomes FALSE or an emergency stop occurs, immediately disable BLOWER_RUN and reset the start timer, whether timing is incomplete or complete. A new demand must wait the full 5 seconds again.
3. Increment AERATION_BLOWER_CYCLE_COUNT once on each FALSE-to-TRUE transition of BLOWER_RUN. Do not count repeatedly during continuous operation.
4. At power-up, initialize the blower to OFF and the start count to zero. The start delay gates a BOOL enable; no continuous speed ramp is required.

## Interface Definition

| Direction | Variable/Field | Data Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Input | `DO_LOW` | `BOOL` | Dissolved oxygen is below its threshold and aeration is needed. |
| Input | `AERATION_E_STOP_NC` | `BOOL` | TRUE means the emergency stop is inactive; FALSE means it is active. |
| Output | `BLOWER_RUN` | `BOOL` | Blower motor-contactor run command. |
| Output | `AERATION_BLOWER_CYCLE_COUNT` | `UINT` | Count of actual blower starts. |
